ideas.pitch: An AI-powered news verification engine that cross-references breaking market feeds with past sentiment and insider chatter to flag fake finfluencer news before trades are executed.
ideas.title: VeritasNews: Fake News & Insider Threat Radar for Simulated Markets
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the specific theme of the trading competition where news sources include unreliable finfluencers and insiders, providing a clear edge in sentiment analysis.

ideas.pitch: A Python-based trading bot platform equipped with market impact models designed to simulate institutional order flows that move virtual prices during the institutional phase.
ideas.title: ApexOrder: Institutional Impact & Market Maker Bot Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the unique dual-phase nature of the event by providing advanced algorithmic trading tools tailored for the institutional tier where large orders move prices.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent advisory council that debates long and short market theses through adversarial falsification before executing trades on the simulation platform.
ideas.title: CouncilTrade: Multi-Agent Adversarial Trading Syndicate
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors proven winning architectures from similar trading hackathons by emphasizing rigorous risk gates and multi-agent thesis testing rather than simple random prompts.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance charting and order book visualization extension that aggregates retail data, charting patterns, and breaking feed updates into a single low-latency dashboard.
ideas.title: BazaarPulse: Real-Time Order Book & Chart Intelligence Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a live-working, high-utility UI that helps retail investors react instantly to second-by-second price changes during intense timed trading sessions.

ideas.pitch: A strict risk-management overlay that monitors open positions, enforces maximum allocation limits, and automatically cuts exposure during extreme market volatility.
ideas.title: RiskSentinel: Deterministic Portfolio Guardrails for Virtual Capital
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven risk-gate engineering patterns to prevent catastrophic drawdowns in high-pressure simulated trading competitions where emotional trading ruins portfolios.
